description: Declared mutants of automatic batching into instanced 3D draws: Queue3d's batches and keys, and sdl_gpu's instanced draw (big-map declaration section 16, v8-arch-gyo2-big-map-s6; I1 to I5; render IN-1 to IN-3). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The in-g3- mutants need a GPU (label gpu: a machine with one, or Lavapipe). Not added (with the reason): the bins' order by their nearest instance (it follows from binning in the sorted order; the sort itself is guarded by p3-opaque-far-first, render_mutations.json); the upload of the frame's instances (no instance at all fails every 3D pixel case, criterion 1: the instance offset and base mutants below already need the right bytes in the right place).

mutants.what: I1: opaque items of one key are never instances of one draw
I2: items of another mesh join the draw
I2: items of another texture join the draw
I2: items of another cull join the draw
I2: items of another depth write join the draw
I2: neighbours of another blend join the draw (overlays, where blend does not set the group)
I2: a neighbour that is not depth-tested joins a depth-tested draw
I4: blended items are binned as the opaque are, joining over items between them
I3: items with geometry of their own (skinned) join a draw
I4: a batch's instances are filled far to near (in a bin) instead of in its items' order
I1: an instance does not carry its item's world
I1: an instance does not carry its item's colour (seen through the World: Mesh3d's colour to the instance)
mutants.cases: render_extract: a scene of one model*

mutants.what: I5: a draw draws its first instance only
mutants.find: SDL_DrawGPUIndexedPrimitives(render, draw.indexCount, draw.instanceCount, draw.indexOffset, firstVertex, draw.instanceOffset);
mutants.cases: sdl_gpu pass3d: a draw of several*

mutants.what: I5: every draw starts at the pass's first instance (first_instance not given)
mutants.find: SDL_DrawGPUIndexedPrimitives(render, draw.indexCount, draw.instanceCount, draw.indexOffset, firstVertex, draw.instanceOffset);
mutants.cases: sdl_gpu pass3d: a draw of several*

mutants.what: I5: a 3D pass's instances do not move the next pass's start
